_comment: Microsoft 365 / Exchange Online via SSO (OAuth2). Basic-auth IMAP is disabled by Microsoft, so use authType:oauth2. Register an app in Azure AD (Entra), add the delegated permission IMAP.AccessAsUser.All + offline_access, enable 'Allow public client flows', then put its clientId (and tenantId, or 'common') here. Run the ms365_login tool once to sign in. No password is stored.
name: Work Microsoft 365

_comment: Microsoft Exchange / Outlook with a legacy app password (only works where basic auth is still permitted).
name: Work Exchange (password)

_comment: Yahoo Mail — requires an app password (not your Yahoo login password). Generate one at: https://myaccount.yahoo.com/security
name: Yahoo Personal

_comment: Apple iCloud Mail — requires an app-specific password (NOT your Apple ID password). Generate one at: https://appleid.apple.com → Sign-In and Security → App-Specific Passwords
name: iCloud

_comment: Generic cPanel / web hosting IMAP, with the password stored in the OS keychain instead of here. Note there is NO 'pass' field: add the account, then run the set_credential tool to store the password securely. Optionally set 'loginTimeout' (ms) to abort a slow login.
name: cPanel Hosting

_comment: Self-hosted or custom Exchange on-premises server
name: On-Prem Exchange
